correctness.rationale: Exact strict-preference cross-multiplications separately on the two sides identify all eligible agents. Choosing independent eligible subsets gives a disjoint composition-indexed count and size polynomial. Pure-side coalitions have utility zero, so cannot strictly block. Rational threshold sorting with Pascal binomial table verifies the arithmetic complexity. In the matched pair partition improvement requirements for paired opposite-side agents conflict; only selected paired first-side and unmatched second-side agents remain, giving the exact binomial expression, the m<=1 core cutoff and exact M(a,2)=a. Independent binomial variables give the conditional-tail identity, the central limit theorem gives Phi(t/sqrt(2)) and LLN/Chebyshev gives the off-critical limits. A standalone exact-rational implementation passed 2,628 full partition cases, 19,814 coefficient comparisons, 450 randomized cases and 90 matched-partition cases. No finite computation is offered as proof of the infinite theorem.

originality.rationale: Checked source statements by implication: the complete multipartite game and strict-core existence are established by Aziz et al.; the epsilon probability is defined by Fioravanti et al.; later bounds address factors and Nash stability. None of the actually inspected relevant theorems yields the exact size polynomial for arbitrary partitions or the derived matching law and Gaussian transition. Literature and related-claim searches across aliases and equivalences yielded no close coverage. A previously unlocated exact enumerator cannot be excluded.
residual_risks: A specialized exact count may have appeared in the broader hedonic diversity/coalition-resistance or binomial-tail literature under other terminology.
Not every appendix or non-indexed full text in all relevant literature has been examined; this is not proof of global priority.
The Gaussian approximation itself uses standard probability theory; novelty is claimed for its exact blocking-probability interpretation in this game family, not the central limit theorem.

value.rationale: A computable exact distribution of sizes of coalitions able to jointly improve is the natural complete invariant underlying epsilon-fractional core stability, not simply a restatement of equilibrium existence. The polynomial evaluation compresses exponential deviation checks to polynomial arithmetic operations. In a canonical matching-plus-unmatched allocation, as few as two unmatched agents create a blocker while the random-blocking probability can remain exponentially small; the Gaussian imbalance window precisely quantifies how matching composition affects conditional susceptibility. These results enable exact finite-population risk evaluation and are not arbitrary parameter substitutions or known core-membership tables.
